reason: With ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 on, AdminPermissions.management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2, whose clients() now returns the new ClientPermissionsV2. Its canExchangeTo(client, to, token) always throws UnsupportedOperationException("Not supported in V2"). AbstractTokenExchangeProvider.java:276 calls it with no try/catch, so token exchange to another client's audience fails with HTTP 500 instead of the 403 at line 280.
